vb_textbox.text: There ae six coloured gnomes, and two coloured baskets/woods. Each gnomes corresponds with a specific basket/wood colour theme. At first you have to take a few rounds to work out the game, it seems like one basket/wood would be more generous with mushrooms at a specific time so I chose the coloured gnome that matched with the specific wood i wanted to go into.
